svg.text: zetokrag/index.py: Index.update. Run when the TUI opens (folders declared), on /index, /add, /remove, by `peresearch index` and `setup`. working tree on 5ca550a, 2026-10-12.
_write_lock: one update at a time, own writer connection
First commit: what the index was built with
another embedder → its vectors deleted (chunks kept)
another chunking or context → every file marked
to be read again; old chunks kept, searchable
guard.outermost: a nested root walked once
hash current bytes even with unchanged metadata
Same sha256 as an earlier path?
yes → 'unchanged'; if its declared folder changed,
its place is updated and embedded again
md, text, code → lines · PDF → pages · ipynb → cells
too_large: text > 20 MiB, PDF > 20 M characters
binary · needs_ocr · error → reported, no chunks
plain text: URLs/numbers, JSON, table, log, word list
code: generated or minified; .sql: a dump
tables, code blocks, lists kept whole (≤ 6,000)
checked: each chunk verbatim at its lines
Replace the file's chunks and row
chunks carry their place (declared folder + path)
Index.embed, after every file is committed
64 chunks a request, each batch committed, fp16;
stoppable, resumable; endpoint down → said, words
meanwhile; a text too long → embedded by its head
60 s since the last commit? → COMMIT
checked: no vector without its chunk;
stopped → this batch rolled back, the rest kept
the extracted-text store made to match the files:
missing texts written, anything else removed
files(path, size, mtime, sha, status, note,
chunks(id, path, section, unit, start, end,
text, sha, place) — ids never reused
skipped(path, reason, note) — rewritten each update
see only committed data (WAL, separate connection):
during a long update, each committed file;
lock wait 30 s set first; WAL switch retried ≤ 30 s,
then a clear error (a drive without WAL)
added, changed, unchanged, removed, denied, largest
